name: Journey Planner Engine 1
summary: Introduces the first generic Journey Planner Engine, powered by domain content, constraints and replace-anywhere planning.
changes: Adds a generic Journey Planner Engine separated from the Casa Amar domain package
Uses structured platform content and relationships instead of fixed day-plan text
Adds plan anchors for Ronda, MTB and diving
Adds replace-anywhere alternatives for individual plan activities
Adds full-day constraint handling for major excursions
Adds reusable runtime state and permanent regression coverage
Synchronizes desktop, mobile and Mission Control identity to v2026.07.24.220
manual_review: Confirm v2026.07.24.220 appears on desktop and mobile
Generate plans across all pace and interest combinations
Build a day around Ronda, MTB and diving
Replace individual activities and verify the plan updates
Confirm gallery, inquiry and navigation remain functional
title: Journey Planner Engine 1
test: Kontrollér, at BETA-badget viser v2026.07.24.220 på både computer og mobil.
Gå til Planlæg opholdet, og skift mellem tempo og interesser.
Vælg Ronda, og kontrollér, at planen reserverer hovedparten af dagen til udflugten.
Vælg MTB og derefter Dykning, og kontrollér, at planen ændrer sig.
Tryk på Vis alternativer ved en restaurant eller aktivitet, og vælg en erstatning.
Kontrollér, at hele planen opdateres omkring det nye valg.
Tryk på Kopiér dagsplan, og kontrollér bekræftelsen.
Kontrollér, at galleri, forespørgselsflow og navigation stadig virker.
Kontrollér, at Mission Control viser v2026.07.24.220.
